The video takes place inside an airplane cabin. A young woman with light brown hair pulled back into a ponytail is sitting in a window seat. She is wearing a light-colored hooded sweatshirt. She looks directly at the camera and talks enthusiastically, gesturing with her hands and displaying a range of emotions, from surprise and excitement to amusement. Behind her, in the next row, a person in a black cap is visible, appearing to be organizing something in their seat. There is another person with blonde hair in the aisle seat to the left. The cabin appears to be modern and well-lit, with comfortable-looking black seats and overhead compartments. The woman mentions that she is going to Paris for her birthday, and someone surprised her at her house to go with her. The camera's focus remains predominantly on the woman in the white hoodie as she speaks.

The video shows a young man with dark hair wearing a white button-down shirt sitting in what appears to be an airplane seat. He looks directly at the camera, speaking and gesturing with his right hand. The plane window is visible behind him on the right, letting in bright light. The seat next to him is black leather. The interior of the plane is visible in the background, with light blue walls. There are no significant visual changes or transitions during the short segment.

The video features a young man in a white button-down shirt sitting on what appears to be an airplane. He is looking at the camera and talking, using hand gestures. At the beginning of the video, he crosses his fingers, then he gestures with his hands as he speaks. He also runs his hand through his hair at one point. The environment is an airplane cabin, with a window visible behind him. The seat next to him is a black leather seat. The background context suggests he is recording a vlog or a message to viewers while on a flight.

The video shows a young man with dark hair and a white button-down shirt in an airplane seat, talking to the camera. He turns the camera to a young woman with light brown hair pulled back in a ponytail, wearing a white hoodie. She waves at the camera and then sits in her airplane seat, smiling and looking at the camera. The man gestures towards her, and she playfully covers her face with her hand in mock surprise before smiling and laughing. She then looks at the camera and smiles. In the background, other passengers can be seen sitting in their seats, some looking at travel documents. The video is shot inside an airplane cabin with light blue walls, black seats, and overhead lighting. The man explains they are going to Paris and that she is his best friend.

The video segment begins with an exterior shot of an airport and the planes present, seen from the inside of another plane, through the window. This transitions to a view of the ceiling of the plane and then to a notebook with notes and Tony Robbins' book "Money Master the Game: 7 Simple Steps to Financial Freedom" laying on the seat. We then see a shot of the airplane wing up in the sky. A title card with the words, "Iman Gadzhi" written in cursive script in black is briefly displayed. Next, a young man in a white shirt gives a short monologue to the camera, talking about how short his flight was as two other passengers, one in a hoodie and the other with a baseball cap, are sitting behind him. The man tugs at the hood of the hoodie of the female passenger in front of him. He continues to speak to the camera. There's a brief shot of the airplane wing landing. We see the girl from before with the hoodie looking into her phone. The man puts his black carry on up into the overhead bin. The video then follows the female passenger in the hoodie down the walkway of the airport, where she is smiling and talking about going to see the Eiffel Tower. The final shot shows the man in the white shirt and black jacket walking through the airport and talking about how fast border control was. The female passenger in the hoodie waves to him from behind.

The video opens with a view of asphalt ground. A man in a black jacket opens the trunk of a black Mercedes-Benz car with the French license plate "DT-631-DW 75." He gets behind the wheel and the scene cuts to the interior of the car, where we see the dashboard and a person in a dark jacket in the driver's seat. Next, a young woman, wearing a white hoodie, is seen sitting in the backseat of the car and talking. The next shot shows the view through the front windshield driving through a tunnel at night with other cars ahead. Another shot shows the young woman in the back seat, looking out the window. Then there’s a shot of the side of a white truck driving in the tunnel. The video transitions to a daytime scene, with the car driving past the Arc de Triomphe in Paris. A young man and the same young woman from earlier are sitting in the back of the car talking. The man tells the viewer, "Trip, practice your French accent." A quick exchange in French follows between the two in the backseat with the woman ending by saying “Merci,” (Thank you). The video transitions to the woman outside a building, adjusting her hair in front of a shop that says "DAMMANN Frères" which is a French tea brand. The man filming is behind her. The man behind the camera says, "Sign up all done. Went to head office. Now it's time to catch a bit of grub?" The woman replies, "Yes I'm so hungry, and I can take a massive sh*t." The man behind the camera adds, "Take a massive sh*t and go to the apartment." and corrects himself, "Or no, go to Parman, take a massive sh*t." The man filming turns to face the camera himself and walks forward.

The video features two young people walking in Paris, France. The camera initially focuses on a young woman with her hair in a ponytail, wearing a light-colored hoodie. The camera then switches to a young man wearing a dark jacket, who remarks about the many French flags and that they are constantly reminded they are in Paris. At one point, the young woman sings, and then the video shows a food stand selling crepes. A sign reads "Crepes 'HOME MADE' 3 Euros," with various flavors listed in French and English, such as "sucre" (sugar), "Nutella," and "chocolat banane" (chocolate banana). Afterwards, the young woman admits that the first thing they want to do is buy a crepe. The environment consists of trees lining the streets adorned with French flags, visible monuments, as well as tourist buses.

The hoodie has text in red letters that says "WHAT THE FUCKED AT THIS RICH." The woman gestures and smiles, as the camera follows her into an apartment room. The room contains a small kitchen area with blue and red checkerboard tiles, and a white dining table. Then the camera shifts to a gray couch with blue cushions. Here is a description of the provided video segment:

The video starts with a young woman in an indoor setting, wearing a black leather jacket with studs on the shoulders, who exclaims "Yay!," noting she looks "so much better than before." A man's voice compliments her, and she smiles. The scene then transitions to an outdoor setting in Paris, where the woman and a young man, who is recording, walk down a street. The woman is holding a Starbucks drink. The man announces they are going to get her first tattoo, and she jokes about getting a croissant tattooed on her. They enter what appears to be an underground tattoo parlor with stone walls. The man then mentions that they couldn't get a tattoo today, but have booked for 2:00 PM tomorrow. A brief shot shows a man spray painting a mural on the street. The woman is then seen laughing as she walks across a bridge over a river, the backdrop featuring Parisian architecture and bustling traffic.

The video segment opens with a wide shot of the Seine River in Paris, featuring tour boats docked along the banks and a bridge in the background. The camera quickly transitions to an interior shot of a tunnel, lit with overhead lights leading towards a bright exit. Inside the tunnel, a young woman with long brown hair is seen walking in the distance, wearing a black jacket with colorful floral and Santa Claus designs on the back. The video then transitions to a closer view of a young man with curly brown hair, wearing a white shirt, who is talking to the camera while walking through the tunnel. He gestures with his hands as he speaks about his plans, and the woman in the floral jacket is briefly seen walking behind him. They emerge from the tunnel, and he continues talking to the camera, touching his hair. The woman joins the frame, laughing and joking with him, as he expresses his desire to move to Paris. He then looks thoughtful and continues talking while standing in front of the tunnel entrance. The sign "Pont du Carrousel" (Carrousel Bridge) can be seen in the background. As he shares his future plans, he looks directly into the camera, at times winking or smiling. The scene is filled with the natural light of the day, reflecting off the river and highlighting the tunnel's stone structure.
